QuestInfo.name: [Maple Leaf High] Ellinia Magic School Principal
QuestInfo.0: Rowen recommended Grendel the Really Old, who was once the principal of the Ellinia Magic School, to be the new principal of Maple Leaf High.
QuestInfo.1: Rowen wants you to test out Grendel the Really Old in the Principal's Office.
QuestInfo.2: You battled Grendel the Really Old's qualifications for the title of principal!
